products.descriptionHtml:
Tourmaline Magnetic Therapy Knee Pads - Self-Heating Support

Innovative knee pads combining natural tourmaline stone therapy, magnetic therapy, and self-heating technology for comprehensive pain relief. Far-infrared heat from tourmaline penetrates deep into knee joint while magnets improve circulation, providing drug-free relief for arthritis, chronic pain, and injury recovery.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Tourmaline Therapy: Natural tourmaline stones emit far-infrared rays and negative ions for deep tissue healing
  • ✓ Magnetic Therapy: Integrated magnets (800-1200 gauss) improve blood circulation and reduce inflammation
  • ✓ Self-Heating: Tourmaline generates heat from body warmth - no batteries or electricity needed
  • ✓ Arthritis Relief: Continuous gentle warmth helps reduce arthritis pain and morning stiffness
  • ✓ Chronic Pain Management: Natural therapy provides sustained relief for ongoing knee pain
  • ✓ Drug-Free: Alternative pain relief without medications or side effects

Perfect For

  • Knee osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis
  • Chronic knee pain and stiffness
  • Cold-sensitive knees needing warmth
  • Poor circulation causing knee discomfort
  • Post-injury pain management
  • Morning knee stiffness
  • Complementary therapy with medical treatment
  • Natural pain relief preference

How to Use

  1. Position knee pad with tourmaline stones/magnets contacting skin
  2. Secure straps above and below knee
  3. Allow 10-15 minutes for self-heating effect to activate from body heat
  4. Wear during daily activities or rest periods
  5. For arthritis: Wear all day for continuous relief
  6. For pain: Wear minimum 2-3 hours daily
  7. Can be worn under clothing discreetly
  8. Consistent daily use provides best results

Care Instructions

Remove tourmaline/magnetic inserts before washing (typically detachable). Hand wash fabric sleeve with mild soap, air dry. Wipe inserts with damp cloth - do not submerge. Replace sleeve when elastic weakens. Tourmaline stones and magnets are permanent - do not require replacement.

Sizing Guide

  • Measure: Knee circumference around center of kneecap
  • S: 12-14" (30-36cm)
  • M: 14-16" (36-41cm)
  • L: 16-18" (41-46cm)
  • XL: 18-20" (46-51cm)
  • XXL: 20-22" (51-56cm)
  • Comfortable fit important for all-day wear

Specifications

  • Technology: Tourmaline stone + magnetic therapy + self-heating
  • Stones: Natural tourmaline (emits far-infrared + negative ions)
  • Magnets: Neodymium magnets 800-1200 gauss (strategically placed)
  • Heating: Self-generating from body heat (no electricity)
  • Material: Breathable elastic, tourmaline-infused fabric
  • Support Level: Light to medium compression
  • Features: Drug-free, no batteries, washable sleeve

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty. Contact us for usage questions.

Medical Disclaimer: This knee pad provides alternative therapy for pain management. Not for treating acute injuries or infections. Contraindications: pacemakers (magnets may interfere), pregnancy (without doctor approval), bleeding disorders, fever, or malignant tumors in knee area. Not a substitute for medical treatment. Consult healthcare provider for persistent knee pain. Results vary by individual.

2PCS Dynamic Knee Support - Elevated Joint Support with Spring Cushion

Innovative dynamic knee support system featuring spring-loaded joint support cushions that actively assist knee movement. Adjustable design relieves pain from strains, sprains, and arthritis while providing powered assistance during activities.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Spring Power Assist: Built-in springs reduce strain on knee joint during movement
  • ✓ Dynamic Support: Moves naturally with your knee, doesn't restrict motion
  • ✓ Pain Relief: Cushions impact and reduces stress on ligaments and tendons
  • ✓ Adjustable Fit: Multiple straps customize compression and support level
  • ✓ Bilateral Set: 2-piece set for both knees
  • ✓ Elevated Joint: Springs elevate and decompress joint during flexion

Perfect For

  • Knee strain and sprain recovery
  • Arthritis pain management
  • Meniscus injury support
  • Ligament strain protection
  • Sports activities (running, hiking)
  • Weight-bearing exercises
  • Stair climbing assistance
  • Daily walking support for weak knees

How to Use

  1. Slide support over foot up to knee
  2. Position spring mechanism on sides of knee
  3. Secure thigh strap snugly above knee
  4. Fasten calf strap below knee
  5. Adjust middle strap for optimal compression
  6. Test fit: knee should flex comfortably with spring assist
  7. Use both knee supports for balanced support
  8. Tighten straps if support slips during activity

Care Instructions

Hand wash straps and pads with mild soap. Wipe spring mechanisms with damp cloth (do not submerge). Air dry completely before storage. Check springs periodically for damage. Do not oil or lubricate springs.

Specifications

  • Quantity: 2-piece set (left + right)
  • Mechanism: Dual-side spring support system
  • Material: Aluminum alloy springs, neoprene straps, EVA padding
  • Adjustment: 3 adjustable straps per knee
  • Size: Universal adjustable (fits most adults)
  • Weight Capacity: Up to 250 lbs per knee
  • Colors: Black with silver springs

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty covers spring mechanism and straps. Contact us for fitting assistance.

Medical Disclaimer: Provides support and pain relief but not medical-grade stabilization. For serious knee injuries (ACL/PCL tears, fractures), use medical-prescribed braces. Not suitable for post-surgical immobilization. If pain increases or numbness occurs, discontinue use and consult healthcare provider. Spring mechanism may make clicking sounds during use - this is normal.

products.descriptionHtml:
Portable Rehabilitation Robot Gloves - Stroke Hemiplegia Cerebral Palsy

Advanced portable rehabilitation robot gloves designed for hand function recovery in stroke survivors, cerebral palsy patients, and those with neurological conditions causing hand impairment. Combines pneumatic assistance, intelligent programming, and repetitive motion therapy to restore hand mobility and strength.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Stroke Recovery: Assists hand motor function recovery through repetitive assisted movement (neuroplasticity training)
  • ✓ Pneumatic Assistance: Air chambers gently flex and extend fingers, preventing contractures and maintaining range of motion
  • ✓ Intelligent Programming: Pre-set therapy routines mimic physical therapist-guided hand exercises
  • ✓ Portable Design: Home-based rehabilitation between clinic visits - use daily for faster recovery
  • ✓ Cerebral Palsy Support: Helps children and adults with CP improve hand function through assisted movement
  • ✓ Adjustable Assistance: Variable support levels accommodate different recovery stages and severity

Perfect For

  • Stroke survivors with hand paralysis or weakness (hemiplegia/hemiparesis)
  • Cerebral palsy patients with hand spasticity or weakness
  • Traumatic brain injury (TBI) hand function recovery
  • Spinal cord injury affecting hand function
  • Hand tendon or nerve injury rehabilitation
  • Parkinson's disease hand rigidity
  • Multiple sclerosis (MS) hand weakness
  • Post-surgical hand rehabilitation

How to Use

  1. Insert affected hand into glove with fingers aligned in designated channels
  2. Secure wrist strap to prevent glove from shifting during therapy
  3. Connect air tubes to control unit
  4. Select program mode (typically 3-5 programs: flexion, extension, grasp, pinch, combination)
  5. Choose intensity level (1-10) based on tolerance and therapy goals
  6. Run therapy session for 15-30 minutes, 2-3 times daily
  7. After session, attempt voluntary hand movements to reinforce motor learning
  8. Consistent daily use essential for neuroplasticity and recovery (minimum 8-12 weeks)

Care Instructions

Remove glove liner (if detachable) and hand wash with mild soap. Wipe pneumatic chambers with disinfectant wipe - do not submerge. Air dry completely. Inspect air tubes for kinks, cracks, or leaks weekly. Clean control unit exterior with dry cloth only. Replace gloves if tears develop or pneumatic chambers fail.

Sizing Guide

  • Measure: Hand width across knuckles (excluding thumb)
  • S: 2.5-3" (6.5-7.5cm) - Children, petite adults
  • M: 3-3.5" (7.5-9cm) - Women's average, men's small
  • L: 3.5-4" (9-10cm) - Men's medium/large
  • XL: 4-4.5" (10-11.5cm) - Men's XL
  • Available in left or right hand - order correct side for affected hand
  • For bilateral stroke: Purchase both left and right gloves

Specifications

  • Technology: Pneumatic compression + intelligent programming + sensor feedback
  • Therapy Modes: 3-5 programs (flexion, extension, grasp, pinch, multi-motion)
  • Intensity Levels: 10 adjustable compression levels
  • Power: AC adapter (110-240V) or rechargeable battery
  • Air Chambers: Individual chambers for each finger + thumb
  • Timer: 15/20/30 minute auto shut-off
  • Certification: FDA-listed Class I medical device (regulations vary by region)

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty. Extended 1-year warranty available (+30 days with registration). Replacement gloves available. Contact us for clinical questions or technical support.

Medical Disclaimer: This rehabilitation device is intended for home use as part of comprehensive therapy program under medical supervision. Always follow your doctor or occupational therapist's rehabilitation protocol. Not for acute hand injuries, open wounds, severe edema, fractures, or uncontrolled hypertension. Consult healthcare provider before use. Results vary by individual, stroke severity, time since injury, and consistency of use. Does not guarantee complete recovery.

  • Features: Breathable, washable liner, x-ray compatible

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty. Replacement foam liners available. Contact us for sizing or fitting questions.

Do not self-treat suspected fractures or severe neck injuries - seek immediate medical attention. Use only as prescribed by healthcare provider. Improper use may cause injury or compromise healing.   • Chronic neck pain lasting months or years

  • Tension headaches originating from neck

How to Use

  1. Sit in chair with good back support or lie down
  2. Place collar around neck with chin resting in front support

Specially designed posture corrector for kids, boys, and girls. Gentle orthopedic support corrects slouching habits early, preventing long-term spinal issues. Lightweight, adjustable design grows with your child while encouraging healthy posture during critical development years.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Child-Specific Design: Sized and engineered for growing bodies, gentler than adult braces
  • ✓ Habit Formation: Trains proper posture during formative years when habits are established
  • ✓ Prevents Future Problems: Early intervention reduces risk of chronic back pain, scoliosis progression, and postural deformities in adulthood
  • ✓ Adjustable Growth: Multiple adjustment points accommodate growth spurts, extends product lifespan
  • ✓ Comfortable & Lightweight: Kids actually willing to wear it - breathable materials won't overheat during school day

Perfect For

  • Poor posture from heavy backpacks
  • Slouching during homework/study time
  • "Text neck" from tablets and phones
  • Mild scoliosis monitoring (under doctor supervision)
  • Upper back rounding (juvenile kyphosis)
  • Post-injury back support during recovery
  • Building lifelong healthy posture habits

How to Use

  1. Help child put on over t-shirt (more comfortable than bare skin)
  2. Guide arms through shoulder loops
  3. Center back panel on spine between shoulder blades
  4. Secure waist strap comfortably (should not restrict breathing)
  5. Adjust shoulder straps to gently pull shoulders back
  6. Start gradually: 15-20 minutes first few days
  7. Increase to 30-60 minutes during homework/screen time
  8. Make it fun: reward consistency, explain why good posture matters

Age-Appropriate Use

Ages 6-10: 15-30 minutes during homework
Ages 11-14: 30-60 minutes during study time
Ages 15-18: Up to 2 hours if needed

Never force - build positive associations with wearing device.

Care Instructions

Hand wash weekly with mild detergent. Air dry completely. Adjust straps as child grows every 2-3 months.

Specifications

  • Age Range: 6-18 years (consult sizing chart)
  • Gender: Unisex - boys and girls
  • Support Areas: Upper back, shoulders, lumbar
  • Material: Lightweight breathable mesh, soft padding
  • Adjustability: Multiple growing stages
  • Weight: Ultra-lightweight design
  • Colors: Kid-friendly options available

Sizing Guide

Small (ages 6-9): Chest 24-28"
Medium (ages 10-13): Chest 28-34"
Large (ages 14-18): Chest 34-38"

Measure chest circumference under arms for best fit.

Tips for Parents

  • Lead by example - practice good posture yourself
  • Combine with posture reminders and back-strengthening exercises
  • Ensure proper desk/chair height for homework
  • Monitor backpack weight (should not exceed 10-15% of child's body weight)
  • Make wearing brace part of homework routine

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty. Growing children? Contact us about sizing up. Support available for parents.

Medical Disclaimer: This posture corrector is for mild posture improvement in healthy children. For diagnosed conditions like scoliosis or kyphosis, use only under pediatrician or orthopedic specialist supervision. Not a substitute for prescribed medical bracing. Key Benefits

  • ✓ ROM Adjustable Hinges: Control elbow flexion/extension range (0°-135° adjustment) for progressive rehabilitation
  • ✓ Post-Surgery Support: Medical-grade stabilization for elbow fractures, dislocations, or ligament reconstruction recovery
  • ✓ Bilateral Hinges: Dual medial/lateral hinges provide superior alignment and prevent unwanted rotation
  • ✓ Progressive Recovery: Gradually increase ROM as healing progresses per doctor's protocol
  • ✓ Breathable Design: Lightweight, ventilated materials reduce heat buildup during extended wear
  • ✓ Adjustable Straps: Secure arm and forearm independently for customized compression and stability

  • Post-operative elbow fracture recovery (radial head, olecranon)

  • Elbow replacement (total elbow arthroplasty) recovery

How to Use

  1. Set ROM hinges to prescribed degree by your surgeon (often locked initially)
  2. Slide arm through brace with hinges aligned to elbow joint crease

Hand wash with mild detergent, air dry flat. Do not submerge hinges. Clean after each use during recovery. Check hinge screws monthly - tighten if loose. Replace foam padding if compressed or worn.

  • Material: Medical-grade breathable composite, aluminum hinges, foam padding

  • ✓ Posture Correction: Pulls shoulders back to counteract forward head posture and rounded shoulders from desk work

  • ✓ Pain Relief: Reduces upper back, neck, and shoulder pain from poor posture

products.descriptionHtml:
Electric Scraping Gua Sha Massage Board

Modern electric gua sha tool combining traditional Chinese scraping therapy with vibration massage and hot compress technology. Meridian dredging device relieves muscle tension, improves lymphatic drainage, and soothes tense muscles with therapeutic heat.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Electric Gua Sha: Modernizes ancient Chinese scraping technique for easier, more effective treatment
  • ✓ Vibration Massage: High-frequency vibration enhances traditional gua sha benefits without excessive manual force
  • ✓ Hot Compress: Therapeutic heat (104-113°F) opens pores, relaxes muscles, improves oil/cream absorption
  • ✓ Meridian Dredging: Unblocks energy pathways (qi) according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles
  • ✓ Lymphatic Drainage: Gentle scraping stimulates lymph flow, reduces puffiness, removes metabolic waste

Perfect For

  • Muscle knots and trigger points
  • Chronic muscle tension and stiffness
  • Lymphatic congestion and swelling
  • Neck and shoulder tightness
  • Back pain from muscle tension
  • Facial lymphatic drainage (with appropriate head)
  • Traditional Chinese medicine therapy at home

How to Use

  1. Apply massage oil or gua sha balm to treatment area
  2. Turn on device and allow to warm up (if using heat)
  3. Select vibration intensity level
  4. Hold board at 15-30 degree angle to skin
  5. Use gentle to moderate pressure
  6. Move in long, smooth strokes following muscle fibers
  7. For meridians: follow traditional pathway maps
  8. For lymph: move toward nearest lymph nodes
  9. Treat each area for 3-5 minutes
  10. Some redness (sha) is normal - not bruising

Treatment Areas

Back: Para-spinal muscles, upper trapezius
Neck: Gentle scraping for tension relief
Shoulders: Release knots and adhesions
Legs: Calves, thighs for circulation
Arms: Forearms for computer-related tension
Face: Lymphatic drainage (gentle pressure only)

Traditional vs. Electric Gua Sha

Traditional: Requires significant manual force, can be painful
Electric: Vibration does the work, gentler, easier to use on yourself
Results: Comparable therapeutic benefits with less effort

Care Instructions

Clean massage surface with alcohol wipe after each use. Do not submerge in water. Store in protective case. Recharge regularly via USB.

Specifications

  • Functions: Gua sha scraping + vibration + heat
  • Vibration Levels: 3-5 adjustable intensities
  • Heat Settings: Low, medium, high (104-113°F)
  • Power: USB rechargeable
  • Battery Life: 2-4 hours per charge
  • Material: Medical-grade stainless steel or ceramic
  • Design: Ergonomic handle, angled scraping edge
  • Weight: Lightweight for extended use

Safety Guidelines

Normal: Mild redness (sha) that fades in 2-3 days
Too much pressure: Bruising (reduce pressure)
Frequency: Wait 3-5 days between treatments on same area
Contraindications: See medical disclaimer below

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty. Contact us for technique questions or support.

Medical Disclaimer: This gua sha device is for Traditional Chinese Medicine therapy and muscle relief. Not medical equipment. Do not use if: pregnant, have blood clotting disorders, taking blood thinners, have skin conditions, varicose veins, or open wounds. Not for use on: inflamed areas, recent injuries, face (without proper training), or areas with neuropathy. Some redness (petechiae/sha) is normal response - not bruising. If excessive bruising occurs, reduce pressure. Do not use on children. Consult acupuncturist or TCM practitioner for guidance on meridian pathways. If pain worsens or new symptoms develop, discontinue use and consult healthcare provider.

products.descriptionHtml:
O/X-Type Leg Corrector Strap - Elastic Leg Straightener

Orthopedic leg corrector designed to address O-type legs (bow legs) and X-type legs (knock knees) through gentle, progressive alignment therapy. Adjustable elastic straps apply corrective pressure to guide legs toward proper alignment, improving posture, gait, and reducing joint stress.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Dual Function: Corrects both O-type (bow legs/genu varum) and X-type (knock knees/genu valgum) leg alignment
  • ✓ Progressive Correction: Adjustable tension allows gradual realignment over weeks/months for lasting results
  • ✓ Elastic Design: Comfortable elastic bands provide consistent corrective force without rigid discomfort
  • ✓ Posture Improvement: Proper leg alignment enhances overall posture and reduces back/hip strain
  • ✓ Joint Protection: Reduces uneven knee/ankle joint wear caused by malalignment
  • ✓ Discreet Wear: Thin design wears under clothing for all-day correction

Perfect For

  • Mild to moderate O-type legs (bow legs) in adolescents/adults
  • X-type legs (knock knees) causing gait issues
  • Leg alignment issues affecting posture and appearance
  • Uneven joint wear from leg malalignment
  • Knee pain from abnormal leg alignment patterns
  • Post-growth spurt alignment correction (teens)
  • Complementing physical therapy for leg alignment
  • Preventing progression of mild leg deformities

How to Use

  1. Determine leg type: O-type (bow legs - gap between knees when standing) or X-type (knock knees - knees touch, ankles separate)
  2. For O-type: Position straps to pull knees inward toward midline
  3. For X-type: Configure straps to separate knees and align legs
  4. Adjust elastic tension - start with minimal correction, increase gradually over weeks
  5. Wear 2-4 hours daily initially, increase to 6-8 hours as tolerated
  6. Use during standing/walking activities for active correction
  7. Combine with strengthening exercises (hip abductors/adductors) for best results
  8. Results typically require 3-6 months of consistent use

Care Instructions

Hand wash elastic straps with mild soap and cold water. Air dry flat - do not tumble dry or expose to heat. Clean weekly with regular use. Inspect elastic for wear or loss of tension monthly. Medical Disclaimer: This leg corrector is designed for mild to moderate leg alignment issues in growing adolescents and adults with flexible deformities. Consult orthopedic specialist before use for proper diagnosis and treatment plan. Most effective when used before skeletal maturity (growth plate closure). Results vary by severity, age, and consistency of use. May not achieve complete correction in all cases. Does not replace surgical correction when medically indicated.

Foreverlily 3D Flexible Silicone LED Mask

Advanced 3D flexible LED mask from Foreverlily with medical-grade silicone construction. Seven color photon therapy treats face and neck with professional results. Flexible design conforms to facial contours for optimal light penetration and comfortable wear.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ 3D Flexible Design: Conforms to unique facial structure for better LED-to-skin contact than rigid masks

  • ✓ 7 Color Photon Therapy: Clinically-proven wavelengths target multiple skin concerns in single device
  • ✓ Skin Brightening Focus: Specialized programs reduce dullness, fade hyperpigmentation, create radiant glow

Perfect For

  • All skin types including sensitive
  • Anti-aging for face and neck
  • Skin brightening and whitening goals
  • Uneven skin tone and texture
  • Acne and post-acne marks
  • Dull, tired-looking complexion
  • Preventative anti-aging maintenance

How to Use

  1. Start with clean, dry face and neck
  2. Optional: Apply water-based serum (not oil-based)
  3. Put on mask like wearing helmet - face first, then adjust neck section
  4. 3D flexible design should conform comfortably to face
  5. Secure with head straps (adjust for snug but comfortable fit)
  6. Connect power cable
  7. Select LED color based on treatment goal
  8. Relax for 15-20 minutes (can read, watch TV)
  9. Use 3-5 times per week
  10. Clean silicone surface after use

Photon Therapy Colors

Red (630nm): Boosts collagen, anti-wrinkle, improves elasticity
Blue (470nm): Antibacterial, acne treatment, oil control
Green (520nm): Brightening, pigmentation fading, calming
Yellow (590nm): Lymphatic flow, skin brightening, immune boost
Purple: Dual red+blue benefits
Cyan: Anti-inflammatory, soothing
White: Comprehensive deep treatment

3D Flexible Advantages

vs. Rigid Masks:

  • Better conformity to nose, chin, forehead curves
  • No gaps between mask and skin (more effective light delivery)
  • More comfortable for extended wear
  • One size truly fits all face shapes
  • Easier to store (folds flat)

Care Instructions

Wipe silicone with damp cloth after each use. Air dry completely. Do not use harsh chemicals. Store flat or in provided case. Keep away from extreme heat.

Specifications

  • Brand: Foreverlily
  • Material: Medical-grade silicone (flexible, hypoallergenic)
  • Design: 3D flexible, conforms to face contours
  • Coverage: Face + neck/décolletage
  • LED Colors: 7 scientifically-calibrated wavelengths
  • LED Count: 150+ high-quality bulbs
  • Power: USB or AC adapter
  • Session: 15-20 minutes, auto shut-off
  • Lifespan: 50,000+ hours

Skin Brightening Protocol

For maximum brightening and whitening results:

  • Week 1-4: Green light, 20 min, 5x weekly
  • Week 5-8: Alternate green and yellow, 4-5x weekly
  • Week 9+: Maintenance - yellow light, 3x weekly
  • Combine with: Vitamin C serum, sunscreen daily

Warranty & Support

90-day manufacturer warranty. Foreverlily customer service available. Contact us for support.

Medical Disclaimer: Cosmetic LED device for skin beautification. Not medical equipment. Do not use if you have: photosensitivity disorders, lupus, epilepsy, skin cancer, or take photosensitizing drugs (certain antibiotics, retinoids). Not for use during pregnancy without doctor clearance. Keep eyes closed during use - LED light is bright. If using prescription retinoids, consult dermatologist before adding LED therapy. For melasma or severe pigmentation, professional dermatological treatment may be more appropriate. Results vary significantly by individual - some see dramatic improvement, others modest. Consistency required - results take 8-12 weeks of regular use.

products.descriptionHtml:
Hip Joint Femoral Fixation Brace - Thigh Fracture Recovery Support

Medical-grade hip fixation brace designed for femoral head/neck fractures, hip dislocations, and post-operative hip stabilization. Provides rigid support to immobilize the hip joint and femoral region during healing after surgery or acute injury.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Femoral Fixation: Rigid stabilization of femoral head, neck, and greater trochanter during fracture healing
  • ✓ Hip Joint Immobilization: Prevents hip flexion/abduction/rotation to protect surgical repair or fracture site
  • ✓ Post-Surgical Support: Essential for hip replacement, hip pinning, or femoral osteotomy recovery
  • ✓ Adjustable Positioning: Set hip angle per surgeon's protocol (typically 0-30° abduction)
  • ✓ Dislocation Prevention: Maintains proper hip positioning to prevent post-op dislocation
  • ✓ Comfortable Long-Term Wear: Padded design suitable for 24/7 use during 6-12 week recovery period

Perfect For

  • Femoral neck fracture post-operative stabilization
  • Hip replacement (total hip arthroplasty) recovery
  • Hip dislocation immobilization and prevention
  • Greater trochanter fracture healing support
  • Hip pinning (internal fixation) post-surgical protection
  • Femoral head avascular necrosis treatment
  • Hip arthroscopy recovery with movement restrictions

How to Use

  1. Your healthcare provider will fit and adjust the brace initially - do not self-fit
  2. Position waist belt securely around pelvis with padding over iliac crest
  3. Adjust thigh cuff to secure femur in prescribed position (typically neutral or slight abduction)
  4. Lock all adjustment mechanisms as set by medical professional
  5. Do NOT adjust hip angle or remove brace without medical authorization
  6. Wear continuously as prescribed - typically 6-12 weeks post-op

Care Instructions

Remove washable padding and hand wash separately with mild soap. Wipe metal/plastic components with disinfectant wipe. Air dry padding completely before reassembly. Inspect locking mechanisms weekly. Contact provider immediately if any component loosens or breaks.

Sizing Guide

  • S: Waist 26-32", Thigh 16-20"
  • M: Waist 32-38", Thigh 20-24"
  • L: Waist 38-44", Thigh 24-28"
  • XL: Waist 44-50", Thigh 28-32"
  • XXL: Waist 50-56", Thigh 32-36"
  • Professional fitting by healthcare provider strongly recommended

Specifications

  • Type: Medical hip abduction/fixation brace (HKAFO style)
  • Materials: Aluminum frame, rigid plastic shells, medical-grade padding
  • Adjustability: Hip abduction angle 0-45°, thigh length adjustable
  • Support Level: Maximum (rigid immobilization)
  • Weight: 2-3 lbs (varies by size)
  • Features: Locking hip joint, adjustable abduction, removable padding

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty on structural components. 1-year extended warranty available (+30 days with registration). Contact us for replacement parts or fitting questions.

Medical Disclaimer: This hip fixation brace is a medical device requiring professional fitting and supervision. Do not use without explicit instructions from your orthopedic surgeon or physical therapist. Improper use may cause injury or compromise healing. This device does not replace medical treatment - follow all post-operative protocols.

Advanced eye beauty device combining EMS micro-current with red light therapy for comprehensive eye area treatment. Targets dark circles, wrinkles, puffiness, and eye fatigue. Professional anti-aging technology for delicate eye skin at home.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Dark Circle Removal: Red light (630nm) increases circulation to reduce pigmentation and hemoglobin buildup under eyes
  • ✓ Anti-Wrinkle Action: EMS micro-current stimulates collagen production, smoothing crow's feet and fine lines
  • ✓ Eye Fatigue Relief: Gentle massage relaxes eye muscles strained from screens, reading, or driving
  • ✓ Puffiness Reduction: Promotes lymphatic drainage to eliminate under-eye bags and swelling
  • ✓ Skin Rejuvenation: Red light therapy improves elasticity, firmness, and overall eye area appearance

Perfect For

  • Persistent dark circles under eyes
  • Crow's feet and fine lines
  • Puffy eyes and under-eye bags
  • Digital eye strain and fatigue
  • Aging eye area concerns
  • Thin, crepey under-eye skin
  • Dull, tired-looking eyes

How to Use

  1. Remove contact lenses and eye makeup completely
  2. Cleanse face and pat eye area dry
  3. Apply eye cream or serum (optional - enhances conductivity)
  4. Turn on device and select mode
  5. Gently place massager wand on under-eye area
  6. Move in slow circular motions from inner to outer corner
  7. Treat crow's feet area with gentle tapping motion
  8. Use for 5-10 minutes per eye
  9. Use 1-2 times daily (morning and/or evening)
  10. Clean device head with soft cloth after use

Treatment Modes

Mode 1: EMS only (muscle toning, wrinkle smoothing)
Mode 2: Red light only (dark circles, rejuvenation)
Mode 3: EMS + Red light (comprehensive treatment)
Mode 4: Massage + vibration (fatigue relief)
Mode 5: Combination (all technologies)

Care Instructions

Wipe device head with soft, damp cloth after each use. Do not immerse in water. Store in protective case. Recharge regularly via USB to maintain battery life.

Specifications

  • Technologies: EMS micro-current + red light (630nm) + vibration massage
  • Treatment Modes: 5 automatic programs
  • EMS Intensity: Adjustable (3-5 levels)
  • Red Light: 630nm wavelength (clinically proven for skin)
  • Power: USB rechargeable
  • Session Time: 5-10 minutes per eye
  • Design: Ergonomic wand, easy to maneuver
  • Weight: Lightweight, comfortable to hold

Expected Results Timeline

Week 1: Reduced puffiness, less fatigued appearance
Weeks 2-3: Slight improvement in dark circles
Weeks 4-6: Noticeable wrinkle softening, improved tone
Weeks 8-12: Significant dark circle reduction, firmer skin
Maintenance: Continue 3-5x weekly to preserve results

Results vary by individual, age, and skin condition.

Usage Tips

  • Best results with consistent daily use
  • Use morning to de-puff before makeup
  • Use evening with retinol eye cream for enhanced anti-aging
  • Store in refrigerator for extra de-puffing effect
  • Pair with adequate sleep and hydration
  • Use gentle pressure - eye area skin is delicate

Warranty & Support

90-day warranty on device and electronics. Contact us with questions or concerns.

Medical Disclaimer: This eye beauty device is for cosmetic purposes. Not medical equipment. Do not use if you have: recent eye surgery, retinal detachment, cataracts, glaucoma, eye infections, or eye injuries. Not suitable for children. Pregnant women should consult doctor before use. EMS sensation should be comfortable - reduce intensity if uncomfortable. Avoid direct contact with eyeball.

products.descriptionHtml:
Robot Rehabilitation Training Gloves - Mirror Therapy Device

Innovative rehabilitation robot gloves utilizing mirror therapy principles for bilateral hand training. Designed for stroke survivors and neurological condition patients, this device helps restore hand function by having the unaffected hand guide the affected hand through movements, leveraging neuroplasticity for recovery.

Key Benefits

  • ✓ Mirror Therapy: Unaffected hand guides affected hand movements through mirrored robotic assistance
  • ✓ Bilateral Training: Simultaneous movement of both hands enhances neuroplasticity and motor learning
  • ✓ Finger-Specific Training: Individual finger chambers allow targeted rehabilitation for each digit
  • ✓ Stroke Recovery: Effective for hemiplegia/hemiparesis hand function restoration
  • ✓ Automated Assistance: Robotics provide consistent, repeatable movements without therapist fatigue
  • ✓ Home-Based Therapy: Practice daily between clinic visits for accelerated recovery

Perfect For

  • Stroke survivors with unilateral hand impairment
  • Mirror therapy protocols in occupational therapy
  • Improving motor function through bilateral training
  • Phantom limb pain management
  • Complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS)
  • Hand function recovery after traumatic brain injury
  • Supplementing clinic-based rehabilitation programs

How to Use

  1. Put gloves on both hands (affected and unaffected)
  2. Connect air tubes and controller to both gloves
  3. Select mirror mode on device
  4. Perform voluntary movements with unaffected hand
  5. Device mirrors these movements on affected hand automatically
  6. Practice 20-30 minutes, 2-3 times daily
  7. Focus attention on affected hand during movements for maximum neuroplasticity benefit
  8. Progress from passive mirroring to active-assist as recovery improves

Care Instructions

Remove glove liners and hand wash separately. Wipe pneumatic chambers with damp cloth - do not submerge. Air dry completely. Inspect tubes and connections weekly. Clean controller exterior with dry cloth only. Replace gloves if tears develop or chambers lose pressure.

Sizing Guide

  • Measure: Hand width across knuckles (excluding thumb)
  • S: 2.75-3.25" (7-8.5cm)
  • M: 3.25-3.75" (8.5-9.5cm)
  • L: 3.75-4.25" (9.5-11cm)

products.descriptionHtml:
Key Features

  • Advanced Vibration Technology: Multi-frequency vibration modes (2800-3200 Hz) specifically calibrated for bunion and foot pain relief
  • Targeted Relief Design: Ergonomically shaped to conform to the bunion area and metatarsal region for precise therapeutic massage
  • 3 Intensity Settings: Low (gentle relief), Medium (therapeutic massage), and High (deep tissue stimulation) to match your comfort level
  • Rechargeable Battery: Built-in 1200mAh lithium battery provides up to 2 hours of continuous use per charge
  • Medical-Grade Silicone: Hypoallergenic, skin-friendly material that's easy to clean and maintain
  • Portable & Lightweight: Compact design (15cm x 8cm x 4cm) weighs only 185g for use anywhere
  • Auto-Shutoff Feature: 15-minute timer prevents overuse and conserves battery life

Benefits

  • Immediate Pain Relief: Vibration therapy increases blood circulation to reduce inflammation and ease bunion discomfort within minutes
  • Reduces Swelling: Improved lymphatic drainage helps minimize fluid retention around the bunion area
  • Prevents Stiffness: Regular use maintains joint flexibility and prevents morning stiffness common with bunions
  • Non-Invasive Treatment: Drug-free, surgery-free solution for managing bunion pain and discomfort
  • Improves Mobility: Reduced pain and inflammation allows for better walking comfort and increased daily activity
  • Cost-Effective: One-time investment replaces expensive recurring physical therapy sessions
  • Stress Relief: Soothing vibrations promote relaxation and reduce overall foot tension after long days

Perfect For

  • Individuals with hallux valgus (bunions) seeking daily pain management
  • Post-bunion surgery recovery (consult physician first)
  • Healthcare workers, teachers, and retail staff who stand for extended periods
  • Seniors experiencing age-related foot deformities and arthritis
  • Athletes dealing with foot stress and metatarsal pain
  • Anyone with plantar fasciitis or general foot fatigue
  • People seeking preventive care for early-stage bunion development

How to Use

  1. Charge the device: Connect the included USB cable to fully charge before first use (2-3 hours for full charge)
  2. Clean the affected area: Ensure your foot is clean and dry before application
  3. Position the massager: Place the device directly over the bunion area, ensuring full contact with skin
  4. Select intensity level: Press the power button to turn on, then cycle through intensity levels (green=low, yellow=medium, red=high)
  5. Relax during treatment: Sit comfortably and allow the device to work for 15 minutes (auto-shutoff activated)
  6. Frequency of use: Use 2-3 times daily for optimal results, with at least 2 hours between sessions
  7. Post-treatment care: Gently massage the area by hand for 1-2 minutes after vibration therapy

Care & Maintenance

  • Cleaning: Wipe the silicone surface with a damp cloth and mild soap after each use. Allow to air dry completely
  • Disinfection: Weekly cleaning with 70% isopropyl alcohol is recommended for hygiene
  • Storage: Store in the provided carrying case in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
  • Battery care: Charge monthly even when not in use to maintain battery health
  • Avoid water damage: Device is not waterproof - keep away from water and excessive moisture
  • Check for wear: Inspect silicone surface regularly for tears or damage; discontinue use if damaged

Technical Specifications

  • Dimensions: 15cm (L) x 8cm (W) x 4cm (H)
  • Weight: 185 grams
  • Material: Medical-grade silicone (body), ABS plastic (internal)
  • Vibration Frequency: 2800-3200 Hz adjustable
  • Battery Type: Rechargeable lithium-ion 1200mAh
  • Battery Life: Up to 2 hours continuous use / 500+ charge cycles
  • Charging Time: 2-3 hours for full charge
  • Charging Port: USB-C with included cable
  • Operating Temperature: 10°C to 40°C (50°F to 104°F)
  • Certifications: CE marked, RoHS compliant

Warranty

This product comes with a comprehensive 12-month manufacturer's warranty from the date of purchase. The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use conditions. Coverage includes motor failure, battery defects, and electronic component malfunctions. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, water exposure, dropping, or normal wear of the silicone surface. To claim warranty service, contact our customer support with your order number and description of the issue. We offer free replacement or repair at our discretion for valid warranty claims.

Medical Disclaimer

Important: This device is intended for temporary relief of minor foot pain and discomfort. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. This product should not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you have diabetes, poor circulation, nerve damage, open wounds, skin conditions, or are recovering from foot surgery. Do not use if you have a pacemaker or other implanted electronic devices. Discontinue use and consult a physician if you experience increased pain, numbness, tingling, or any adverse reactions. Not recommended for use during pregnancy without medical consultation. Keep out of reach of children. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA.
